pages.text:
Craft up to 8 conduits of one kind with a Plastic Sheet and a dye to sheathe them in that colour. They keep their stats.
- Sheathed conduits only join conduits of the same colour, or unsheathed ones.
- So two red and blue lines can run side by side without merging.
- Put a sheathed conduit in the crafting grid on its own to strip the sheath.
